children: may fall to $94.09 per barrel, following its failure to beak a resistance at $96.93.

The failure suggests a completion of a wave c, the third wave of a three-wave cycle from $89.16. A channel technique and a Fibonacci retracement analysis reveal a target of $94.09, the 38.2% level on the rise from $89.16 to $97.13.
Resistance is at $96.16, a break above may lead to a gain to the $96.93-$97.76 range. On the daily chart, the contract failed to break a resistance at $96.57.
The failure, along with the doji during the previous trading session, suggests a completion of the bounce from $89.1, or the first leg of this bounce.
The market may test the support at $93.96, which is close to $94.09 (hourly chart).
